profile.headline: Software Engineer | Machine Learning Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and Machine Learning Engineer, with experiences in AI Inference/Training, GPU/CUDA Acceleration, Optimization and Distributed Services. Full stack development (front/backend), software engineering, machine/deep learning, data science, quant and cloud infrastructure

Working experience in companies like 𝐏𝐚𝐲𝐏𝐚𝐥/𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐒𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐬/𝐓𝐢𝐤𝐓𝐨𝐤/𝐒𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐞/𝐆𝐨𝐯𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡/𝐆𝐈𝐂

𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐞𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐀𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬

• Gold Awards for both the Singapore Chemistry Olympiad (Top 20 nationally) and Singapore Mathematical Olympiad, selected for 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐞𝐚𝐦 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠

projects.title: Online Detection of Human/Bot on Auction platform (Facebook Recruiting IV)
projects.description:
Partook in a Kaggle Facebook Recruitment classification competition.

Performed data cleaning, with extensive feature engineering on more than 7 million bids to accurately predict whether the bid was made by a human or a robot. 

Implemented ensemble learning models (XGBoost, CatBoost, GradientBoost, RandomForest) to achieve an optimal AUC score of 0.8917 scored on private data from the competition. 

Achieved top 500 on Kaggle global leaderboard (from 2014)
